coverage_definition: Successful Bisabosqual A/F route from local starting-material preparations, with direct optimization byproducts and recycling. Ancillary model chemistry and catalyst synthesis excluded explicitly.

external_identity_crosschecks.scope: Identity crosscheck only; reaction evidence remains local article/SI

issues.detail: Includes successful A/F route, fragment 11/24 preparation, directly connected byproducts and recycle experiments. Earlier C-H activation, lithiation, protecting-group model networks and NHC catalyst synthesis are outside this target-route dataset.
issues.subject: model studies

issues.detail: S60 scheme reports 93%, procedure 91%; primary yield follows procedure.
issues.subject: SI19

issues.detail: S59 scheme says THF, procedure diethyl ether; primary solvent follows procedure. DMF mmol also inconsistent with amount.
issues.subject: SI18

issues.detail: S66 scheme and main Figure 6 give 83%; SI isolation gives 84%. Use 84% combined cis/trans, plus separate 13% lactone 54c.
issues.subject: 53c

issues.detail: S68 calls ester 23 instead of 53c; main Figure 6 calls organolithium 26 instead of SI 24; S77 calls substrate phenol 30 instead of drawn 61a. Follow structures and linked preparations.
Main Figure 6 defines 60a OTs and 60b OH; main page 7 prose reverses labels. Graph labels follow Figure 6; 40% tosylate and 20% alcohol preserved.
issues.subject: 60a/60b

issues.detail: Main room-temperature TFA/DCM optimization gives 72% 4:3 constitutional mixture; S74 neat TFA at 0 C then room temperature gives 69% 84:16 epimer mixture. Distinct events, not interchangeable yields.
issues.subject: 61a/61b

issues.detail: S77 table uses 2 equivalents TiCl4 for mixed products but representative procedure says 2.5; optimized table uses 4 equivalents. Epimer ratio 86:14 in scheme versus 84:16 in characterization.
issues.subject: 62a/62b

issues.detail: S78 scheme/main state 18 h for oxidative lactonisation; S79 procedure says 3 h. Conditions not fully standardized.
SI gives 1.6:1 endo:exo, main gives 2:1; 84% is combined. Exo-67 recycled to 65 in separate 81% preparation.
issues.subject: 67/exo-67

issues.detail: Source absolute stereobonds retained; rac-11 remains unassigned racemate. Drawn major graphs and interpreted named minor epimers do not imply pure material. Racemic analytical calibration 52c is not a synthetic target branch.
issues.subject: stereoisomers

issues.detail: Unisolated methyl adduct, productive epoxide and phthalide-reduction diol are explicit procedural interpretations with no allocated yield.
issues.subject: 57-adduct/epoxide/diol

issues.detail: Resubjection of enol ester 55 gives no conversion; acid opening of 66 fails. No fabricated productive edges.
